author: 3owj
content: Done (uncommitted): SourceEntry::visible_for_course (tags apply to every kind) + SourceEntry::is_dormant(active_courses) in manifest.rs. sources_for_scope takes active_courses; Topic/Resource scopes exclude dormant; Session/MultiSession/Course filter by course match (so a leftover session from a retired course still sees its own sources); explicit --source includes dormant. Flat vaults (no active_courses) have no dormancy. 4 new tests; old 'non-textbook always included' test inverted.
